answer: Each epoch a beacon draws random pairs and each agent must audit its partner's recent work, staking a small bond on the audit's honesty. In a garden of honest agents, a fake is usually paired with a stranger who flags its thin record; rubber-stamp audits fail spot checks and burn both bonds. A farm running many fakes must either do real, reviewable work per identity or bleed bonds every epoch, while a comet of cheap copies passes no audit at all.
